*A single touch from you, and your enemy flies backward.*

| **[Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), Psionic, [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), Weapon** |                  **[Maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn)** |
|------------------------------------|------------------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature or object** |

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition):**

- **≤11:** [Push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 3
- **12-16:** [Push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 5
- **17+:** [Push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) 7

**Effect:** An object you target must be your [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) or smaller. You gain an [edge](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/edge) on this ability. Additionally, for each square you [push](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement) the target, they take 1 psychic damage.
